description: List businesses covered by a Lodestar Stamp draft record. Optional market reads that market's index; omitted reads the primary record.

cursor.description: Optional next_cursor from the previous list_index answer on the same market. Omit for the first page; each page lists at most 50 businesses.

market.description: Optional market slug from list_markets, for example chicago-hvac. Omit for the primary index.

name: list_index
title: List Covered Businesses
